name: hifz-buddy
description: Website to help those memorizing The Holy Quran to track their progress highlighting their areas of strength and weakness

paragraphs: Hifz Buddy helps people memorizing the Quran (hifz) see exactly where their memorization is strong and where it needs revision. You log how many times you recited a passage, at any size from a single ayah to a whole juz, and the app turns that into a colour map of the entire Quran.
features: Log any portion of the Quran: juz, hizb, quarter hizb, page, half page, page range, surah or ayah range.
Starting point: new users mark what they have already memorized and rate how strong each part feels, so the map is accurate from day one.
Four map views of memorization strength, all coloured from Not yet to Strong:
Rings: juz, hizb, quarter and page rings; click a juz to zoom into its pages and half pages
